points.K6: 进去的人要清楚在做什么

points.K9: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头
points.K10: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光
points.K11: 维修人员按规程开护罩
points.K12: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条黄黑链条前，旁边贴着黄色激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a yellow and black chain barrier next to a yellow laser warning sign.
shots.narration: 警示标志、贴纸和链条，要听它们的。
overlay: 遵守激光警示标志、安全标贴与隔离栏

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 警告标志、贴纸、链条三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a laser warning sign, a warning sticker and a chain barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 老李带我们去机器背面看看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 办公区门口，老李对着镜头讲话，几位访客在旁
shots.prompt_en: At an office door, the facility engineer talks to the camera while a few visitors wait.
shots.narration: 老李又要带客户进车间了。

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 访客们指着激光切割机，满脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: Visitors point curiously at a laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 客户都想看看我们在做什么。
overlay: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 家、办公室和车间三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a home, an office and an industrial workshop with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 他们习惯家和办公室，不熟悉工业车间。

shots.section_title: 访客不熟悉车间，要照看
shots.scene: 老李走在访客身旁，伸手示意他们跟紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks beside the visitors and gestures for them to stay close.
shots.narration: 所以要照看好他们。

shots.section_title: 正面有地垫，背面没有
shots.scene: 机器正面铺着黑色安全地垫
shots.prompt_en: A black safety mat lies in front of the laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 机器正面有安全地垫。

shots.section_title: 正面有地垫，背面没有
shots.scene: 老李走到机器背面，地上什么也没有
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the back of the machine, where the floor has no mat.
shots.narration: 到了背面，就没有这种装置了。

shots.section_title: 背面用链条拦住
shots.scene: 背面通道口拉着一条黄黑相间的链条，旁边是氧气储罐
shots.prompt_en: A yellow and black chain is stretched across the back walkway, next to an oxygen tank. No people.
shots.narration: 所以背面用链条拦住。

shots.section_title: 背面用链条拦住
shots.scene: 老李拉开链条，像拉一根安全拉绳
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stretches the chain out like a safety cord.
shots.narration: 像安全拉绳一样拉开，

shots.section_title: 背面用链条拦住
shots.scene: 链条图标和地垫图标之间一个约等号
shots.prompt_en: A chain icon and a floor mat icon with an approximately-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 起到类似的保护作用。

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 维修人员图标拿着工具站在背面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a maintenance technician with tools at the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 背面通常只有维修人员进来。
overlay: 背面是维修人员的地方

shots.section_title: 背面是维修人员的地方
shots.scene: 光路反射镜座和校准工具
shots.prompt_en: A beam path mirror mount with an alignment tool beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 在这里做光路校准这类工作。

shots.section_title: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住
shots.scene: 老李沿背面走，指着导轨和风琴管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the back and points at the rail and the folding bellows.
shots.narration: 背面有风琴管，有导轨。
overlay: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住

shots.section_title: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住
shots.scene: 龙门架在导轨上来回滑动
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the gantry slides back and forth along its rail while cutting. No people.
shots.narration: 切割时，整个龙门架来回滑动。

shots.section_title: 防被龙门架和风琴管缠住
shots.scene: 人被运动部件卷住的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person caught by a moving gantry, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 链条就是防止人被它缠住。

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 背面的检修面板、电线和气路
shots.prompt_en: Service panels, wires and gas lines on the back of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 检修面板、气路要维护时才进来。
overlay: 进去的人要清楚在做什么

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 老李背对镜头，看着检修面板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, back to the camera, looks at a service panel.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，进来的人得清楚在做什么。

shots.section_title: 进去的人要清楚在做什么
shots.scene: 一个人不知不觉走进去的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person wandering in without noticing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能稀里糊涂走进来，受了伤。

shots.section_title: 链条挂着：不得进入
shots.scene: 老李手拉链条
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the chain with his hand.
shots.narration: 链条挂起来，

shots.section_title: 链条挂着：不得进入
shots.scene: 链条图标连到禁止进入标志
shots.prompt_en: A chain icon linked to a no entry sign. No people.
shots.narration: 就是“不得进入”的警示。

shots.section_title: 光路上到处是黄色警示贴
shots.scene: 老李走到出光口和反射镜座旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the laser output and a mirror mount.
shots.narration: 再看光路上这些贴纸。
overlay: 光路上到处是黄色警示贴

shots.section_title: 光路上到处是黄色警示贴
shots.scene: 光路护管和镜座上贴着一张张黄色激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Yellow laser warning signs stuck on beam tubes and mirror mounts all along the beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色警示贴，到处都是。

shots.section_title: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头
shots.scene: 示意图：激光在柜内产生，经几面反射镜转向，送到切割头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the laser beam is generated in a cabinet, bounces off a series of mirrors and goes down to the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 激光在柜子里产生，
overlay: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头

shots.section_title: 光从柜里经反射镜到切割头
shots.scene: 光束在镜子间整形、转向的动画
shots.prompt_en: Animation of the beam being shaped and turned between mirrors. No people.
shots.narration: 经过一组反射镜整形、转向，送到切割头。

shots.section_title: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光
shots.scene: 老李手扶反射镜座，指着上面的贴纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests a hand on a mirror mount and points at the sticker on it.
shots.narration: 每一张贴纸都在说：
overlay: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光

shots.section_title: 贴纸的意思：后面可能有激光
shots.scene: 护罩揭开，后面有一条光路
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a cover is lifted and a beam path is right behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 揭开这里，后面可能有激光束。

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 维修人员图标揭开护罩，查看反射镜
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a technician removing a cover and checking a mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 维修人员懂得怎么规范作业。
overlay: 维修人员按规程开护罩

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 镜座上放着一个对中靶，光斑落在靶心
shots.prompt_en: An alignment target placed on a mirror mount, with a spot in its center. No people.
shots.narration: 揭开护罩查镜片，在镜座上用靶对中。

shots.section_title: 维修人员按规程开护罩
shots.scene: 激光关闭的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A laser-off icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 他们清楚，这时不会出光。

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 开着激光揭开护罩的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cover lifted while the laser is switched on. No people.
shots.narration: 可要是揭开护罩又开了激光，
overlay: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 看不见的光束示意：一条虚线和一只闭着的眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an invisible beam drawn as a dotted line, next to a closed eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 光束射出来，是红外光，看不见。

shots.section_title: 开盖出光：看不见，会起火
shots.scene: 虚线光束落在纸箱上冒起火苗
shots.prompt_en: The dotted beam lands on a cardboard box far away and a flame starts. No people.
shots.narration: 打到哪儿，就可能在哪儿起火。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现地垫、链条、禁止进入、黄色贴纸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a floor mat, a chain, a no entry sign and a yellow warning sticker.
shots.narration: 背面没有地垫，链条挂着不得进入。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 黄色贴纸和虚线光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning sticker icon and a dotted invisible beam icon. No people.
shots.narration: 贴纸后面可能有光，红外看不见会起火。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在链条前挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the chain barrier.
shots.narration: 听从警示，下次见！
